# Cycling Training Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into an evidence-based cycling coach grounded in peer-reviewed sports science: it designs training plans (8-week base builder, 16-week indoor season, 16-week outdoor season templates), calculates FTP-based power zones (Coggan 7-zone, Seiler 3-zone, iLevels), prescribes intervals and sweet-spot workouts with execution guidance, plans periodization (base → build → peak with mesocycle load:recovery ratios), and analyzes training load (TSS, IF, VI, CTL/ATL/TSB, ACWR) with warning signs for overtraining — plus indoor-training setup (fan, cooling, ERG vs slope mode), nutrition and recovery guidance, and dedicated sections for masters, women, beginners, and time-crunched athletes. Ships with Python calculation scripts (zone calc, TSS, weekly analysis) and a companion-skill integration for intervals.icu data. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it targets equipped cyclists — a power meter or smart trainer gets you the most value, and the Python scripts are optional helpers, not the core; the intervals.icu companion skill is optional (bring your own data or import manually); as with any training program, this is coaching guidance, not medical advice — the skill flags cardiovascular red flags and says to seek medical evaluation when warranted. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
